solution: We will organize events to promote regional collaboration using Cardano. Our focus is on practical use cases like regional tokens and wallets, highlighting how they support sustainable development.

title: Cardano Symphony: A New Era of Music Data Insights
problem: Current music analytics tools lack transparency and often fail to provide artists with actionable insights. Our project aims to empower musicians by offering real-time data analytics on music's perf.
solution: We will develop 'Cardano Symphony,' a decentralized platform that provides musicians with real-time analytics and insights, enhancing transparency and empowering artists to make informed decisions.

title: Smart Transaction Batching for Optimized Cardano Network Efficiency
problem: High transaction fees and network congestion hinder Cardano's adoption for small transfers and microtransactions. Users avoid frequent interactions, limiting ecosystem growth and utility.
solution: Develop a platform that efficiently bundles multiple transactions reducing fees by up to 25% and easing network congestion. This enables cost-effective microtransactions and frequent usage

title: Building Smart Contracts: A Comprehensive Learning Platform for Cardano Developers to Improve Skills in Plutus and Lucid Frameworks.
problem: Developers struggle to learn and implement smart contracts due to complex tools and a lack of accessible educational resources, which limits innovation and adoption in the blockchain space
solution: We will create a complete online learning platform that includes interactive courses and practical tutorials, allowing developers to understand and execute smart contracts rapidly and confidently.

title: Knowledge is Power: Cardano’s Turkish Initiative
problem: The Turkish Cardano community lacks adequate educational resources and media representation, hindering user understanding and engagement with the ecosystem's innovations and governance.
solution: We will produce 90 educative articles in Turkish about Cardano's advancements, fostering community engagement, correcting misconceptions, and enhancing awareness of its value.

title: VeriDATA: Cardano Verifiable Data Collection Platform
problem: Organizations and individuals lack a trusted, decentralized platform for collecting and verifying data, leading to inefficiency, unreliable information and increased risks in decision-making processes
solution: We will create VeriDATA, a decentralized platform on Cardano for collecting, verifying and securely managing data, empowering users with reliable, trustless and transparent information.

title: We will build a site where user can purchase V-Preca with tokens such as ADA. Users can purchase V-Preca using the tokens they own, and by issuing a real card, they can make payments at VISA member stores in Japan.
problem: In Japan, the spread of crypto has been slow due to strict regulations.We are building an infrastructure that allows tokens to be used for payments, and will promote the growth of the crypto market.
solution: Slash Payment is a decentralized and non-custodial payment gateway that enables merchants to accept any type of tokens as payment while receiving the same transaction in their preferred stable token.

title: Core DAO DApp for on-chain community collaboration
problem: NFT communities on Cardano lack an engaging, intuitive and streamlined application to collaboratively manage treasury assets and encourage broad community-driven decision-making
solution: We will develop an engaging, intuitive and streamlined DAO DApp, enabling Cardano NFT communities to seamlessly integrate on-chain, community-driven decision-making and collaboration

title: Cardano Quest, Promote your DeFi for the cardano community
problem: Many creative DApps and DeFi initiatives have trouble taking off and being noticeable in the crowded blockchain market. Traditional marketing techniques frequently fail to captivate consumers.
solution: Using Cardano Quest DeFi's and Dapp's can increase their user base, increase their social media followers and do their TestNet programs while users will be learning about projects, and win prizes.

problem: Providing a 3D file enables unlimited prints, risking IP protection. Limited encryption and no standard formats complicate monetization and royalty tracking, with no central control for distribution.
solution: Iagon and Würth's NFT-Smart Contract platform on ORSY Connect secures 3D IP with decentralized storage, automates royalties, and establishes a global marketplace for 3D printing IP and services

title: Expanding Cardano Awareness in Turkey
problem: There is low awareness and understanding of Cardano’s blockchain technology in Turkey, limiting its adoption and potential to drive innovation and economic growth.
solution: We plan to launch educational initiatives and community-driven campaigns to increase knowledge of Cardano and boost its adoption within Turkey’s tech and blockchain ecosystem.

title: The DeSci Journals
problem: **The DeSci Journals** address the problem of Authors' copyright expropriation by the scientific publishing industry while generating 26/ year in revenue for publishers (more than the cinema industry!).
solution: A platform for the creation of technical and scientific publications, leveraging web3 principles and technologies: 100% copyright to authors, % of authorship and scientific assets construction.

title: Snickerdoodle: Revolutionizing Digital Advertising with Blockchain.
problem: The digital advertising landscape lacks transparency and fairness, often resulting in unbalanced benefits for advertisers and users. Snickerdoodle creates a rewarding ecosystem for all participants.
solution: We will build the Snickerdoodle Ad Network, a blockchain platform that rewards users and publishers with tokens, ensuring transparency while enhancing engagement and brand visibility.

title: Uniting Innovators Worldwide with Cardano Idea Connect
problem: Many innovators submit similar proposals on Cardano, leading to duplicated efforts, missed funding, and collaboration opportunities. This platform will connect like-minded creators for success.
solution: We will create a platform that connects innovators on Cardano, using AI to match similar ideas and facilitate collaboration, empowering creators to turn their visions into impactful projects.

title: Cardano Big Brain: An Open-source Decentralized Cardano LLM
problem:
Cardano developers face steep learning curves, fragmented resources, and lack a decentralized AI tool. Centralized LLMs can’t fully address privacy, scalability, and Cardano-specific needs.

[https://youtu.be/IN0lB6esH\_s](https://youtu.be/IN0lB6esH_s)[https://youtu.be/v\_4LhZrDabw](https://youtu.be/v_4LhZrDabw)<https://youtu.be/Zq0F5sWE9DY>
solution: We propose upgrading [**cDPT-1**](https://github.com/Flux-Point-Studios/cDPT-1) to an open-source Cardano-specific LLM, hosted across decentralized nodes, providing developers with dynamic, real-time assistance & fostering Cardano growth.

title: The Entrepreneur Space: Fostering Cardano's Business Ecosystem
problem: Cardano entrepreneurs lack a dedicated platform to share experiences, challenges, and solutions, hindering the ecosystem's growth and limiting collaborative opportunities for business development.
solution: Weekly meetups where Cardano entrepreneurs present their companies, discuss challenges, and share insights, fostering a supportive community and accelerating ecosystem growth.

title: Open-Source Prediction Market Smart Contracts
problem: Cardano lacks a prediction market infrastructure to enable effective crowd-sourced forecasting and leverage its financial ecosystem for predictions, hindering its competitiveness.
solution: We will develop open-source prediction market smart contract templates for Cardano, enabling users to create decentralized markets for crowd-sourced forecasting.

title: Identus: Complete SD-JWT-VC Support
problem: Identus (Atala PRISM) needs community developer support to complete an important feature: SD-JWT-VC Support.
solution: We will complete SD-JWT-VC support in Identus, adding Revocation and the ability to issue and selectively disclose SD-JWT-VC Edge Agent to Edge Agent

title: Rare Affiliate Hub: Cardano Sales, Payroll, Promo Codes, & Bounties Management Platform - Powered by Rare Network / Rare Evo
problem: There is no affiliate sales, payroll, bounty & promo code management platform built on Cardano. Businesses need the ability for affiliates to share promo codes & earn commission onchain automatically.
solution: Rare Network will build an affiliate hub platform, allowing KOLs/partners to share promo code/product links, track sales activity, and auto payout commissions on purchases in Cardano native assets.

title: Integrating Hydra Scaling into Cardano Kuber Library
problem: Existing Cardano libraries lack support for Hydra transactions, limiting developers' ability to build scalable DApps using Hydra's Layer 2 scaling.
solution: We will add Hydra transaction support to the Kuber library, enabling developers to build scalable DApps using Hydra's Layer 2 scaling on Cardano.

title: Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKP) SDK for Privacy in Cardano
problem:
Cardano DApps grow in complexity, especially in privacy, compliance and data protection, there's a need for privacy-preserving solutions. Without a ZKP SDK, developers face challenges integrating ZKP

![ZKP SDK for Cardano](/a/community-id/163/attachments/embedded-files/ZKP-2-99cbdc/png)
solution: Zero-Knowledge Proofs SDK for Cardano will be an open-source toolkit enabling developers to easily integrate ZKP into DApps and smart contracts to simplifies ZKP for privacy, compliance and voting.

title: [ DjedAlliance - StableOrder ] Djed Shu Stablecoin Implementation
problem: Current versions of Djed available on Cardano are stable but sensitive to oracle delays and manipulations. This requires high minting and redemption fees for drainage protection, hindering adoption.
solution: We will implement the Shu version of Djed. Djed Shu uses two oracle prices to be more robust against oracle issues. This allows lower base fees for minting and redemption.

title: ADA Wallet for Salesforce
problem: There are no ADA wallets with a UX/UI that is familiar to enterprise users who use Salesforce, the world's leading customer relationship management (CRM) software.
solution: ADA Wallet for Salesforce plugs into ADA for Salesforce, the transaction app, or can be run on it’s own.

title: Cardanoscan: Analytics Charts V2
problem: Current Cardano analytics lack visual tools for deeper insights into key metrics like ADA circulation, Mempool size etc. Users need more detailed, informative charts to better understand the ecosystem
solution: We will enhance the Cardanoscan analytics page by adding new charts, such as ADA circulation vs reserves, mempool size, stake key growth, and treasury growth, providing better insights to users

title: Digital Marketing Training for 200 SMEs in Ghana
problem: Digital marketing benefits Ghanaian SMEs, yet a skills and knowledge gap hinders their growth. While aware of digitization, SMEs struggle to fully leverage its potential for business expansion.
solution: This proposal trains 200 SMEs in digital marketing and raise awareness of Cardano and Project Catalyst through 8 sessions, each with 25 participants, equipping them with essential digital skills.

title: Cardano Full-Stack dApp Framework Simplifying On-Chain and Off-Chain Development
problem: Developing dApps on Cardano is complex due to fragmented tooling for on-chain and off-chain development. Developers need an integrated framework to streamline the entire process efficiently.
solution: We will create an open-source Cardano Full-Stack dApp Framework that integrates on-chain and off-chain development, streamlining the dApp creation process for developers.

title: Intangibles: Web3 interface for experience-based art
problem: Despite the growing number of artworks with an experiental element, legacy institutions continue to be the venue of choice for lack of alternatives, and as such it remains an untapped market.
solution: A platform where creators can mint an experience, where facilitators can implement a derivative experience, and users can book experiences or otherwhise exchange rights over original experiences.

title: Telegram Smart Wallet for dReps and delegators (Account Abstraction in Governance)
problem:
There is disconnect between dReps and delegators in Cardano governance, due to a lack of integrated tools within familiar Web2 social platforms for efficient voting, communication, and delegation.

solution: A Telegram Smart Wallet that integrates gov tools, enabling dReps & delegators to easily vote, communicate, & delegate within a familiar Web2 platform in a fully abstracted, gasless, & intuitive way.

title: Latam Cardano Governance, Mentorship and Community Hub Growth
problem: Bridging the gap in Latam countries without Cardano presence by providing governance education, mentorship, and community hubs building to foster ecosystem growth and decentralized participation.
solution: Establishing Cardano hubs in underserved Latam countries to provide governance education, mentorship, and resources, fostering local engagement, decentralized participation, and ecosystem growth.

title: Community CIP Editor Robert Phair: 8 month budget
problem: Like all top blockchains, Cardano has a standards process to support developers and new applications: Cardano Improvement Proposals (CIPs) require editors to help build standards into our ecosystem.
solution: Robert Phair has 3 years experience as a Community CIP editor (not employed by Cardano companies), and continuing Catalyst funding of Cardano's standards process will keep driving our ecosystem value.

title: Cardano Lagos Festival 2025: Catapulting Africa Into An Era Of Decentralized Governance.
problem: **Mass Adoption and Brand Visibility:** Cardano suffers mass adoption and visibility as a blockchain brand, especially in Africa.
solution: To organize a large-scale Cardano event in Lagos to create more brand awareness and visibility for Cardano in Africa.

Cardano participation in a three-week pop-up city in Mexico

title: Orcfax development of composite oracle feed
problem: There is a need for oracle data to generate composite oracle output (eg price smoothing feed) with archival references to source/input data and reproducible calculations for composite data output.
solution: Orcfax will leverage its previously published on-chain data to publish composite prices (eg SMA) and will develop an auditable archival package with a full provenance chain for price-feed integrators.

title: Decentralized Mental Health Solutions on Cardano: Enhancing Accessibility and Support
problem: Barriers like stigma and high costs prevent access to mental health support. Our platform offers a decentralized, confidential solution to enhance accessibility and help reduce this stigma
solution: We will build a decentralized mental health support platform connecting users to professionals in a confidential space. This enhances accessibility, reduces stigma,and empowers underserved communities

title: Advanced and Clear Cardano Explorer:
problem: **Current blockchain explorers on Cardano lack advanced visualization features, making it difficult for users to analyze complex data and smart contract interactions effectively and intuitively.**
solution: **We will build an advanced Cardano explorer with interactive visualizations, real-time updates, and smart contract analytics to simplify blockchain data analysis for all users.**

title: CHARLI3: Self-Service Pull Based Oracle Platform with Open-Source SDK
problem: The process to request, launch, and integrate an oracle feed is costly, cumbersome, and time-consuming. It requires contracts, manual configuration, and team discussions.
solution: An automated self-service system that enables builders to request, launch, and integrate a pull-based oracle feed for **any permutation of CNT price pair** available on Cardano DEXs in minutes.

title: Treasury and Catalyst Withdrawals: Analyzing their Impact on ADA Market Price
problem: As Cardano enters the Voltaire era, large ADA withdrawals from the treasury (e.g Catalyst) may cause volatility and instability, with limited analysis on their impact, leaving the ecosystem vulnerable
solution: We'll create a dashboard to track ADA price volatility, liquidity and market trends after Catalyst and treasury withdrawals, providing insights to reduce volatility and improve disbursement strategies

title: The Guidebook to Cardano Governance
problem: Cardano has the most ambitious and advanced Blockchain Governance system ever created. We need published materials that tells this story to the world and teaches Ada holders how they can participate.
solution: We have a team from the Cardano community who were actively involved with developing and testing Cardano’s decentralized governance system. We will write and publish a book about Cardano governance.

title: Decentralized Peer-to-Peer Physical Storage Rental Platform on Cardano
problem:
A global platform for renting nearby physical storage is lacking. Current options are limited in availability, expensive, lack transparency, and are inefficient, causing environmental waste.

![freepik_edit-1-daf461.png](/a/community-id/163/attachments/embedded-files/freepik_edit-1-daf461/png)
solution: We will build a decentralized storage rental platform, solving issues of high costs, inefficiency and lack of transparency using smart contracts enabling secure peer-to-peer physical storage globally.

title: TuxChain - A Linux Distro for build and deploy Cardano Nodes in a easy way
problem:

solution: Build a Linux distribution with a quick and easy GUI configuration environment, which can be installed on a USB drive or embedded in a mini-PC, simplifying the deployment of a Cardano node.

title: CertiMuni - Decentralized Municipal Certificate Issuance Platform
problem: Municipalities face document falsification and slow, manual processes for issuing certificates, generating inefficiency and citizen distrust.
solution: CertiMuni uses the Cardano blockchain to enable municipalities to issue immutable and verifiable digital certificates, improving efficiency and transparency.

title: [Concept] Improve Cardano Governance Security
problem: Vulnerabilities in Cardano’s governance process can result in community conflict or even outright attacks. If not addressed, they can cost anything from millions in dollars to Cardano’s reputation.
solution: Research, identify and suggest solutions to potential vulnerabilities and attack vectors within the wider Cardano governance process, specifically focusing on the threat of Contentious Hard Forks.

solution: Xlend is a smart-contract-based leveraged trading client. It will utilize Lenfi V2 pools for liquidity and will allow users to create permissionless leveraged positions in Cardano native tokens.

title: Automating Smart Contract and dApp Development
problem: Complexity of Dapp development hinders developers from utilizing Cardano's blockchain. Our solution aims to simplify this process.
solution: We will develop a user-friendly platform for creating smart contracts on Cardano with minimal coding requirements, making blockchain technology more accessible and encouraging broader participation

title: Cardano Mobile Multisig Wallet
problem: The absence of user-friendly mobile multisig wallets on Cardano prevents organizations and groups from securely managing shared funds, hindering collaborative use and broader ecosystem adoption.
solution: We will develop an open-source mobile multisig wallet for Cardano, enabling secure joint account management and transactions, enhancing security and usability for enterprises and groups.

title: DLT360: MVP for Fund 11 - AuditShare, A Powerful Audit Sharing Platform
problem:

solution: Build a platform that connects unemployed Ethiopians with higher transactions per second happening in ADA, and train employability skills at networking events while educating them about Cardano.

solution: We'll create Cardano Code Lab, an online IDE with integrated debugging for Plutus smart contracts. This all-in-one tool will streamline development, boost productivity and accelerate ecosystem growth.

problem: Simplify onboarding for users who find usernames and passwords more convenient than wallets.
solution: A smart wallet, uniquely identifiable with a username, where users can manage their funds with a password.

solution: We will survey the Cardano ecosystem about people's sentiment & behaviour regarding DeFi, NFTs, IOG, CF, governance. We will share that data in an attractive and interactive manner.

title: Fida, AdaLife: Onchain life insurance
problem: The citizens of Cardano need easy access to life insurance. We have an underwritten product and with the community the reach is real and for the all those who need it
solution: We will explore what a fully on-chain life insurance product will look like, from proof of life to proof of death. Insureds will have seamless transactions and a few clicks to get a simple life cover

title: SAIB: Buriza.Core – The Library Behind Buriza, the Truly Open Source, Cross-Platform Cardano Wallet
problem: Many Cardano wallets rely on centralized servers, lack transparency, limit user control, and provide inconsistent user experiences, making them vulnerable, closed source, and difficult to customize.
solution: **Buriza.Core**, a subset of **Buriza**, is a library powering a decentralized open-source Cardano wallet, letting users self-host and self-install, ensuring asset security without relying on third parties.

title: Cardano Techmarket Care
problem: The absence of certified e-waste collectors and the lack of affordable repair services contribute to indiscriminate dumping of devices, further increasing e-waste levels.
solution: We propose the development of a **Decentralized Application (DApp)** that connects device users with repair experts and certified e-waste collectors.

title: Cardano Tutorial for 150 Dire Dawa University Students, Ethiopia
problem: Due to lack of blockchain education, Ethiopian University students miss development opportunities. This project offers tutorials, preparing 150 learners to excel in decentralized tech and innovation.
solution: We will provide **150 students** at Dire Dawa University with Cardano blockchain lessons that cover basic ideas realworld applications and practical handson development experience on the Cardano platform.

title: DePIN- Atala Prism for Radio Frequency Identification Infrastructure- Developers
problem: Current RFID infrastructures lack secure, decentralized identity management, leading to inefficiencies ,data privacy fears in authentication ,Compatibility with payment systems. and ticketing systems
solution: We will build an RFID infrastructure integrated with Atala PRISM for secure, decentralized identity management, streamlining ticketing and authentication with Cardano blockchain technology.

title: A DEX for NFTs: Collectibles Exchange
problem: Current infrastructure lacks dedicated services for collectors to easily swap non-fungible Cardano native assets. Most Cardano NFT services focus on financial aspects, neglecting NFTs as collectibles.
solution: A prototype DEX enabling users to swap NFTs directly. Final product will include an innovative on-chain, partially on-chain, and off-chain offer mechanics, increasing transaction volume.

title: LFS in cardano(loan free student in cardano)
problem: Helping students save in ADA to accumulate enough funds for repaying student loans, pursuing further education (MSc abroad), or achieving their dreams after graduation.
solution: LFS in Cardano enables students to save monthly in ADA, building funds for loan repayment and supporting their dreams, like pursuing an MSc abroad.

title: RYP: Keeping the Cardano Ecosystem Informed, Anytime, Anywhere
problem: Currently, Cardano users and businesses miss important on-chain events and project updates due to fragmented communication channels, leading to disengagement and reduced adoption.
solution: We will enhance RYP to provide personalized notifications of on-chain events and project & infrastructure updates directly to people's preferred channels, bringing together decentralized communities.

title: Cardano Starter Kit: Simplifying dApp Development on Cardano
problem: Cardano's complex smart contract languages and limited dev tools create a steep learning curve, slowing dApp development, increasing costs, and challenging developers' entry into the ecosystem.
solution:
We will create a platfrom providing ready-to-use templates, smart contract examples, and integrated tools to simplify DApp development, reducing costs and accelerating

DApp creation on Cardano.

Loss of information that we want to preserve for the future due to various reasons is a social issue.

We aim to solve issues by storing information on the Cardano blockchain.

title: Empowering Farmers and Merchants: A Cardano-Based Platform for Agricultural Growth and ADA-Backed Financing
problem: The problem I’m solving is the lack of direct access to markets and financial services for rural farmers, helping them sell products to merchants and access loans through the Cardano ecosystem.
solution: The problem is the lack of direct access to market services for rural farmers, that prevent there business growth. My project connects farmers with merchants and provides access to ADA-based loans.

title: EMDDI: The Future of Transparent and Efficient Ride-Hailing
problem: NewTaxi: Transparency in fare, cash flow, income, and driver selection, unlike current apps with fixed fares and random drivers
solution: EMDDI enables instant earnings for taxi drivers via blockchain, ensuring transparent, efficient transactions, solving income delay issues.

solution: DeTask helps talent contribute to cardano projects through bounties and freelance gigs, in exchange for earning in CNTs.

problem: Existing lending platforms are either peer-to-peer or pooled, causing transaction contention and reliance on batchers for settlement.
solution: Smart Lending introduces an order book lending model on Cardano that allows partial loan fulfillment, eliminates transaction contention, and removes the need for batchers by utilizing multiple UTxOs.

title: Decentralized Job Marketplace on Cardano
problem: Freelancing platforms have high fees, long payment delays, and lack transparency in dispute resolution. Workers and clients face challenges with fair payments and maintaining verifiable reputations.
solution: job marketplace on Cardano using smart contracts for secure payments, verifiable reputations, and automated dispute resolution, reducing fees and increasing transparency for freelancers and clients.

solution: We will build an open-source system using Midnight-Cardano blockchain for medication traceability, ensuring authenticity, safety, and protecting sensitive medical data across the entire supply chain.

title: The Visual Cardano: Discover Cardano Knowledge Through Dynamic Visuals

title: AI-Driven Blockchain Transactions for the Cyber Economy
problem: Web2 and Web3 platforms interfaces are the past. Users seek intelligent systems that make interaction the most simple, so we want that Blockchain transactions can be executed from LLMs dialog windows
solution: Seamless AI assistant that can execute blockchain transactions through natural language dialogs. No complex dashboards, no confusing wallet addresses, no manual steps—just ask, and it gets done.

title: Cardano Gallery and Library - A Comprehensive Library for Everything Cardano

solution: We will create a centralized Gallery and Library platform that consolidates resources, guides, tools, and news in one place, making it easy for users and developers to access everything they need.

title: Solvel Flow – Solve It Right, Solve It Bright

problem: Non-profits often face inefficiencies in process management, transparency issues, and difficulties in raising funds. These challenges hinder their ability to maximize impact.
solution: We will create tailored workshops for NPOs, teaching them how to use Cardanos blockchain to address process inefficiencies, increase transparency, and improve fundraising mechanisms.

title: INTU: Safe Web3 Account Protocol for Mass Adoption.
problem: INTU addresses the challenge of mainstream Web3 adoption by providing a secure, user-friendly account protocol that simplifies on-chain user onboarding without compromising privacy or decentralization
solution: We will create INTU, a chain-agnostic account protocol and toolkit that enables developers to onboard users seamlessly onto Web3 with secure, customizable, and easy-to-implement solutions.

title: Decentralized Content Distribution Network
problem: Current content distribution platforms are centralized, imposing high fees, restricting creator control, and enabling censorship. This limits fair compensation and access.
solution: We will create a decentralized content distribution network using Cardano, enabling secure, censorship-resistant sharing, transparent royalty payments, and fair compensation for content creators.

title: Midnight and Self-Sovereign Identity enabled Money Transfers
problem: International money transfers are often expensive, delayed, and insecure. The reliance on traditional financial systems results in high fees and slow processes, preventing timely access to funds.
solution: We propose developing a P2P platform using Midnight to facilitate fast, secure, and low-cost transnational money transfers with integrated Cardano Self-Sovereign identity (SSI) solution

title: NEWM: New Artist Account Setup Assistant

title: Cardano Wallet Management System
problem: Current Cardano wallet solutions lack user-friendly interfaces and streamlined processes, making it difficult for users to manage assets securely and efficiently.
solution: A Django-based Cardano Wallet Management System offering a secure, user-friendly interface for creating, managing, and conducting transactions efficiently.

problem: There is a lack of practical implementations for MiCA-compliant EUR stablecoins on Cardano, limiting users' ability to mint and burn such stablecoins and hindering DeFi innovation.

solution: DataWell - a secure marketplace where data providers are compensated in cryptocurrency for sharing health data, fostering diversity and accelerating medical innovation with strong privacy protections.

Designing and developing an **open-source** Cardano Desk Watch with **DIY** assembly instructions ,a **3D-printed case** , **e-ink display** and customizable **dashboards** software.

solution: Create eco-friendly candle bags branded with Cardano, raising awareness of blockchain in Ethiopia while promoting sustainability, local business, and community engagement through practical products.

title: cPoker: Open Smart Contracts for Multi-User Value Exchange in dApps
problem: Cardano dApp developers need access to practical, *non-trivial* examples of working smart contracts for *interactively exchanging value* with *multiple participants*.
solution: We are developing open smart contracts for cPoker, a peer-to-peer protocol for escrow and payout with poker rules. We'll provide it openly so many real-world dApps can benefit from it.

title: USDH: Stablecoin as a Hyperstructure
problem: Cardano would benefit from a fully decentralized stable coin with no rent-seeking value extraction, the only fees are those paid directly to collateral providers as incentive.
solution: USDH is a concept for a fully decentralized stable coin completely owned and governed by collateral providers.

title: Women of web3 platform in Ethiopia
problem: Lack of Female Representation and participation in the Cardano Ecosystem in Ethiopia.
solution: Aims to address gender imbalance in the Cardano ecosystem by providing an inclusive space for Ethiopian women. It offers educational resources, networking programs, and a dedicated project showcase.

title: Cardano Ambassador Tools
problem: We dont have the tools we need to effectively support Cardano Ambassadors in their roles and activities
solution: We ideate, define and build 2 tools Ambassadors need and want

title: Jupyter Notebooks Support for Plutus Smart Contracts
problem: Cardano lacks an accessible interactive development environment for Plutus smart contracts, hindering experimentation, learning, and rapid prototyping for developers.
solution:
An iHaskell-based Jupyter environment for Plutus will be developed, enabling interactive smart contract development, testing, and learning in Jupyter notebooks.

![jupyter_plutus](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/community-id/163/attachments/embedded-files/jupyter_plutus-a62d8e/png)

title: Lockpod: Decentralized Self-Custodial Wallet for Multi-Chain Asset Management
problem: The core issue is the lack of a secure, decentralized solution for managing digital assets across blockchains, preventing users from losing access or relying on centralized entities.
solution: We will build Lockpod, a decentralized P2P wallet network that secures and manages digital assets across blockchains without users needing to handle private keys or rely on centralized entities.

title: Survey on Cardano Blockchain Awareness Among College Students and Project Catalyst Newcomer Introduction
problem: Cardano and Catalyst need to be popularized to young people in Ho Chi Minh City because awareness and application of Cardano in Vietnam is still hindered.
solution: Surveying students at universities to learn about their opinions and misconceptions about blockchain (Cardano). Organizing workshops on Cardano in conjunction with Catalyst to promote the ecosystem

title: Secure IoT Device Management on Cardano
problem:
IoT devices face security risks from poor management and a lack of interoperability. Cardano's blockchain can provide a secure, decentralized solution to enhance data integrity and user trust.

![6.ipt-problem-22cd74.jpg](/a/community-id/163/attachments/embedded-files/6.ipt-problem-22cd74/jpg)
solution:
We will create a secure IoT management platform on Cardano that ensures data integrity, enhances interoperability, and builds user trust, addressing the security and management issues effectively.

![6.Secure_IoT_Device_Management_on_Cardano-69007e.jpg](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/community-id/163/attachments/embedded-files/6.Secure_IoT_Device_Management_on_Cardano-69007e/jpg)

title: Ticketing with SIKI
problem: Current event ticketing systems often suffer from issues like high fees, lack of transparency, and vulnerability to scalping. Middlemen take significant cuts, reducing artist and venue profits.
solution: SIKI can offer a seamless platform for artists to manage both digital content and live events, creating new revenue streams and closer fan connections while solving longstanding industry problems.

title: Revuto - The first CROSS-CHAIN SWAP on Cardano! Swap the most popular cryptocurrencies for Cardano Tokens and back in seconds like; BTC to IAG, SOL to SNEK, ETH to MIN, USDT to USDM...
problem: Swapping BTC/SOL/ETH to CNTs is a terrible experience. Users must register with CEXs and use non-custodial Cardano wallets and Cardano DEXs, which is a massive hindrance to cross-chain onboarding.
solution: Revuto has a non-custodial Cardano and custodial Crypto wallet, which makes it perfect to offer the first cross-chain swap feature in a single app on Cardano to easily swap top Crypto tokens for CNTs.

title: Diversum: An Inclusive Platform for Neurodivergent Individuals
problem: Neurodivergent individuals face social isolation and barriers to meaningful interaction on traditional platforms, which lack adaptation to their unique communication and socialization needs.
solution: Diversum provides an inclusive platform tailored for neurodivergent individuals, promoting meaningful connections through accessible design, education, and a safe community supported by the Cardano.

title: Typhon Wallet: Seamless Multi-Signature Features
problem: There is currently no multi-signature support in Typhon, preventing secure and collaborative management of ADA and tokens by multiple stakeholders, limiting its utility for shared wallet management.
solution: We will implement multi-sig support in Typhon using native scripts, enabling the creation and management of wallets with multiple signers for secure, handling of ADA, tokens, staking, and governance.

title: AttentionSDK: Deploy On-Chain Marketing Campaigns in One Click to Help Projects and Developers Build Distribution (Open-Source Galxe/Zealy Clone)
problem:
Cardano projects suffer from high failure rates, due in part to poor marketing. The ecosystem faces a lack of open-source tools for creating automated campaigns that incentivize user engagement.

![Image file](/a/community-id/163/attachments/embedded-files/embedded-idea-description-image-59c532/png)
solution: Our open-source SDK allows projects to launch one-click on-chain marketing campaigns that automatically reward users for completing tasks, expanding project reach & user acquisition.

title: Cardano Ambassador Workshop - Europe
problem: There is a lack of initiatives to support and increase interactions, collaborations and self-governed coordinations amongst Cardano Ambassadors
solution: We ideate, organise and execute a new ambassador in-person workshop format to increase coordinations and collaborations amongst local Cardano Ambassadors

title: AI-Driven Multi-Language Learning Platform for the Cardano Ecosystem Using Generative AI
problem: lack of accessible, multi-language learning resources for the Cardano ecosystem, limiting global user adoption and understanding. We aim to solve this with AI-driven, multilingual, interactive content
solution: **We will create an AI-driven platform offering multilingual courses and resources for the Cardano ecosystem, enabling global users to learn in their preferred language through generative AI.**

title: Marlowe for the Future: Financial Smart Contracts for 5,000 Rural Innovators
problem: Rural areas lack education on blockchain-based financial contracts, limiting their ability to create and manage decentralized financial solutions using Marlowe.
solution: Equip rural students with Marlowe education, teaching them to create and manage financial smart contracts, empowering them to address financial challenges in their communities.

title: Merit Based Reputation Engine Model for Cardano Ecosystem : Enhancing Trust and Accountability

Voters still have the problem of making decisions from a large number of proposals and reviews are not seen by many people as a reliable source of information about the quality of proposals.

solution: Provide a groundbreaking solution Merit Based Reputation Engine for catalyst That aims to address the current trust and accountability challenges by evaluating all activity & enhancing the credibility

title: Unleashing Cardano’s Power: Innovative Marketing Ideas at Major Blockchain Events
problem: Cardano’s innovations are underrepresented at major blockchain events, reducing global awareness and understanding of its potential, which limits adoption and community growth.
solution: Attend 3 major blockchain events, including Cardano events, to promote Cardano, create educational content, and boost awareness, ensuring Cardano's innovations are highlighted to a global audience.![2024-10-05-23.25.19-7ea08d.jpg](https://cardano.ideascale.com/a/community-id/163/attachments/embedded-files/2024-10-05-23.25.19-7ea08d/jpg)

title: Decentralized Skill Verification Platform on Cardano
problem: The process of validating skills is slow,centralized and prone to fraud. Institutions and companies struggle to verify credentials efficiently,while individuals lack control over their certifications.
solution: A decentralized skill verification system, allowing individuals to securely store and share credentials. Institutions can issue trusted certifications on-chain for easy third-party validation.

title: TapTools: Stablecoin Ecosystem Dashboard for Cardano
problem:
![Web-1920--360-2098d8.JPG](/a/community-id/163/attachments/embedded-files/Web-1920--360-2098d8/JPG)

solution: **We will create a dashboard that consolidates detailed data on Cardano’s stablecoins, giving users easy access to key metrics, such as liquidity, collateralization, and risk exposure.**

title: Superintelligence for Cardano: Groundbreaking Integration for AI-Powered dApps
problem: Cardano needs more transaction volume to sustain its ecosystem. The race to AGI presents an opportunity to make the resources of the Artificial Superintelligence Alliance (ASI) accessible to Cardano.
solution: Connect Cardano to the ASI through Fetch.ai's uAgents Framework, providing access to a decentralized, autonomous, and intelligent resource for streamlining complex tasks and decision-making processes.

title: Empowering Developers: Open Innovation on Cardano
problem: Developers struggle with limited access to Cardano’s advanced tools and resources, hindering dApp innovation. We aim to break these barriers, empowering creators to build scalable, impactful solutions
solution: We will create a developer hub with easy-to-use tools, tutorials, and direct support to streamline dApp development on Cardano, removing technical barriers and fostering innovation.

title: Csign: Public API
problem: **Csign** lets you privately sign and certify anything. Developers should have access to a public API and embed the power of **Csign** in their own applications.
solution: **Csign** will create a public API, exposing its signing, certification, and verification functionality so developers can create powerful, private agreement signing features in their own applications.

title: RWA focused permissioned layer 2 for Institutions and Govts
problem: Institutions and governments require secure, scalable, and compliant solutions for managing Real World Assets (RWA) on blockchain but face issues with public chain privacy and regulations.
solution: A permissioned Layer 2 on Cardano, tailored for RWAs, offers institutions and governments secure, compliant, and private blockchain infrastructure for asset tokenization and management.

title: IMPACT PLUS - Which Catalyst projects succeed and why?
problem: The issue is the lack of understanding around which Project Catalyst initiatives succeed, and why. Without clarity, future cycles may repeat mistakes, waste resources, and miss growth opportunities.
solution: This research aims to analyze completed Catalyst projects, identifying success factors and trends to improve funding decisions and boost post-grant survival rates for future initiatives.

title: WP NMKR Connect 🔌 - WordPress Plugin to Display & Manage Cardano/Solana NFTs
problem: There is no easy solution for WordPress users to display and manage NFTs on Cardano and Solana blockchains. WP NMKR Connect solves this by offering an integrated plugin for seamless NFT management.
solution: We will develop WP NMKR Connect, a WordPress plugin that integrates Cardano and Solana NFTs, enabling users to easily display, manage, and interact with NFTs on their websites via NMKR.

title: TREEdano: a Regenerative NFTrees dApp
problem: In the East region of Cameroon and throughout the Congo Basin, rare and iconic tree species are facing over-exploitation, yet there’s no comprehensive plan in place to restore them.
solution: Enhance DIT's existing Treedano dApp by adding supporting modules and expanding use cases to attract more users, fostering an Eco-conscious community while creating innovative funding opportunities.

title: Driving Cardano Adoption Through Educational Events Across Asia
problem: The lack of awareness and education about Cardano's technology hinders grassroots adoption in Asia. Many developers and businesses are unaware of its potential, limiting community growth.
solution: Host educational workshops, hackathons, and networking events across Asia to educate developers and the community about Cardano, fostering growth and adoption.

title: Digital Course on Idea Generation for Cardano
problem: Many potential contributors lack the skills to generate ideas and write effective proposals for Cardano projects. This limits community engagement and stifles innovation within the ecosystem.
solution: We will create a digital training course that teaches idea generation and proposal writing tailored for Cardano, empowering individuals to effectively contribute and innovate within the ecosystem.

title: Extend Open-Source One-Click Wallet to support mass actions
problem: One-Click Wallet lacks support for multiple wallets and mass actions. We aim to add features like one-click delegation and Catalyst voting across all wallets, improving efficiency for users.
solution:
We will extend One-Click Wallet to support multiple wallets and mass actions, enabling one-click delegation or Catalyst voting across all wallets, simplifying governance and wallet management.

problem: The problem we aim to solve is the lack of a decentralized, anonymous communication network that allows users to make VoIP calls and send SMS to real-world phone numbers without compromising privacy.
solution: We will build a decentralized VoIP platform, allowing users to make calls & send SMS to real phone numbers while maintaining privacy Powered by Cardano users can earn rewards by running lowpower nodes

title: Teaching Web3 and blockchain to Ghanaian high school students, giving them useful foundational knowledge, and introducing Cardano to encourage future blockchain users and developers.
problem: High School students in Ghana have less or no knowledge about web3 and blockchain due to lack of adequate education. With this, Cardano isn’t well known amongst the youth in Ghanaian high schools.
solution: We plan to host Web3 and blockchain education workshops for Ghanaian high school students to teach the fundamentals of blockchain technology, cryptocurrencies, and the Cardano ecosystem as a whole.

title: Switchchord: Amplifying Rights Management with Trusted Data

title: Local Business Funding
problem: My project aim to provide local businesses with ADA-based funding from investors, offering them a stake or profit share upon success, creating a transparent, secure platform on the Cardano blockchain.
solution: The project creates a secure ADA-based platform where businesses receive funding, and investors earn a stake or profit, solving trust and accessibility issues in traditional funding methods.

title: Protocol Risk Simulation Engine built by Xerberus

title: Cardano Summit on Bolivia's Bicentennial

solution: We are going to organize the first Blockchain technology summit in Bolivia and Cardano will be the protagonist. We will have webinars, workshops and a fair with universities as the mayor event.

title: CFC( cardano for commerce)

problem: Token launches on the Cardano network are currently overly complex. We aim to address this challenge by creating a comprehensive launchpad suite, streamlining the process for users and projects.

title: Explore Cardano and Governance with Gamified Quizzes
problem: There is a lack of online resources for educating people about Cardano and its governance mechanisms.
solution: We will create interactive, gamified quizzes to provide an engaging and accessible learning experience about Cardano and its governance, addressing the lack of online resources.

title: Systematic Blockchain Knowledge Survey Among College Students
problem: Many assumptions exist about the knowledge gaps among students, however, no systematic investigation exists that empirically documents exactly where these gaps are.
solution: Conduct a large-scale survey across multiple universities to uncover student attitudes and misconceptions about blockchain/Cardano, building profiles to guide Cardano's future outreach efforts.

title: Cardano Workshops: Unlocking Potential in Northern Brazil
problem:
In Brazil events focused on Cardano and cryptocurrency are scarce in the north. This lack limits access to information and stifles community engagement and development in an area rich with potential

solution: We will hold workshops across the northern capitals of Brazil to educate and engage the community on Cardano and cryptocurrency, fostering knowledge and collaboration in a region rich with potential.

title: Clarity X Plug and Play: On-Chain Investment Arm for Cardano Ecosystem Investments
problem: High-potential projects in the Cardano ecosystem lack investment to continue development and drive adoption.
solution: Plug and Play Ventures will establish an on-chain investment arm to fund and grow promising Cardano projects.

title: AI-powered Autonomous Cardano Stake Pool Operator
problem: Stake Pool management is difficult, especially for small teams of people without a deep technical background.
solution: SPO system with LLMs to call functions that control delegation strategies, monitor network health, and enhance uptime, resulting in efficient pool operation with minimal human intervention.

title: Protofire - Developer Studio v2
problem:
![Dev Studio v2: Advancing Cardano Smart Contract Development](/a/community-id/163/attachments/embedded-files/Screenshot-2024-10-08-190117-5f091b/png)

Cardano smart contract development remains complex, with scattered tools and a steep learning curve, hindering ecosystem growth and developer adoption.
solution: Dev Studio v2 provides an integrated development environment with VS Code extension, streamlining Cardano smart contract creation, testing, and deployment across multiple languages.

title: VYFI: Fix For Incorrect Datums Resulting in "Burnt" Assets on Chain
problem: If you create a transaction and submit it, and for whatever reason the datum is malformed or missing - it is possible to lock assets on chain forever, effectively burning those users' assets.
solution: The solution is to modify our smart contract languages like Aiken, and Plutus to automatically include a way to withdraw when a UTXO is un-spendable. That way users don't unknowingly burn assets.

title: AI-Powered Cardano Documentation Portal
problem: Cardano's developer documentation is overly complex, hindering adoption and participation.
solution: An AI-powered Cardano documentation portal that simplifies content and provides on-demand explanations to lower the barrier for new developers, driving increased adoption of the platform.

title: Cardano DeFi Adoption: DEX, Staking, and Lending PR Campaign
problem: Cardano’s DEX, staking, and lending platforms lack visibility and clear narratives, resulting in limited adoption and engagement compared to competing DeFi ecosystems.
solution: Leverage targeted PR to amplify Cardano’s DeFi capabilities in DEX, staking, and lending platforms, attracting liquidity, users, and developers.

title: Universal Decentralized Voting System (UDVS) – A Blockchain-Based Global Voting Platform for Transparent, Secure, and Inclusive Elections Using Cardano.
problem: Traditional voting systems face manipulation, centralization, and transparency issues, leading to insecure elections and decision-making processes.
solution: The Universal Decentralized Voting System (UDVS) leverages the Cardano blockchain to create a secure, transparent voting framework using smart contracts and Atala PRISM for identity verification.

title: Cardano EasyDev VS Tool
problem: We develop a VS extension for easy Aiken smart contract deployment with a GUI, marking our first Cardano contribution after winning top prizes in Sui, Near, and Algorand developer tools.
solution: The purpose of the proposal is to develop a VS extension to deploy Aiken smart contract with GUI easily to facilitate smart contract development and developer learning curve of Cardano.

title: Cardano India Developers Community Hub
problem: Indian has large pool of developers, Most of them not aware of Cardano or they don’t find required support groups. Cardano India Developers Community Hub continuity is required
solution: Cardano India Developers Community Hub to organize activities and events online and offline to build awareness about Cardano ecosystem and support the developers in process to learn and work on it

title: FIDA: Etherisk contracts on Cardano
problem: The Fida community in its mission to support decentralised insurance agencies across the entire crypto landscape cannot do so, unless our contracts interact with other systems on other blockchains.
solution: By allowing Cardano wallets to interact with etherisc contracts on EVM chains, Fida is able to offer insurance agencies on those platforms through its collaboration with etherisc.

title: Starc₳da: Cardano, IAGON, Midnight, Anti-cheat, Player Reward Indie Game Publishing Platform

solution:
Starcada offers Plutus leaderboards and rewards smart contracts, IAGON web hosting and an anti-cheat online score system enabled by zero-knowledge smart contracts

solution: Iagon Private Distributed Cloud Service (PDCS) will demonstrate a proof of concept with the Fortune 500 company for a pilot app that will be installed on the infrastructure of the company.

title: Visualized Tool for Transaction Building in Cardano
problem: A user-friendly Cardano transaction builder is missing, limiting access and slowing feature adoption. Existing tools are either too technical or limited to basic wallet functions.
solution: Our solution is a user-friendly UI for Cardano transactions, integrating all functionalities of Cardano transactions, making complex transactions easy for both developers and non-technical users.

title: Takt Protocol - Enhancing Cardano's DeFi with under-collateralized flash loans for eUTXO
problem:
![Summary](/a/community-id/163/attachments/embedded-files/Fund12-Catalyst-VAULT3-Forms-visual-8ddf7b/png)

Cardano's DeFi needs a flash loan protocol specialized in under-collateralized loans (one-transaction liquidity) for arbitrage and trading bots.
solution: Takt Protocol: a decentralized and non-custodial liquidity market protocol inspired by AAVE that offers under-collateralized (one-transaction liquidity) flash loans via smart contracts for eUTXO.

title: Maintain latest aarch64 (ARM) compliant static binaries for Cardano SPOs, developers and users
problem: Static binaries for Cardano are not readily available for Linux on aarch64 devices used by SPOs and other users who run their Cardano-related operations using low-powered SBCs, like the Raspberry Pi.
solution: Provide ongoing support to build a variety of Cardano binaries statically, especially cardano-node and cardano-cli, so any SPO who uses aarch64 devices can benefit from timely updates.

title: Saleen x Pierre Auto Group: On-Chain Vehicle History Reports Implemented in USA Dealership Network for Guaranteed minimum of 100,000 Vehicles
problem: Expanding upon our F12 submission, we've improved our proposal to address the silo'd vehicle[ titling process](https://www.wolterskluwer.com/en/expert-insights/title-washing-and-types-of-vehicle-titles#:~:text=At%20its%20most%20basic%2C%20title,you%20spot%20potential%20title%20issues.) in America which opens the door to fraud and mistrust in the auto industry.
solution:
Create a system that puts VIN numbers & history reports onchain, then roll out to at least 100,000 cars in the USA distributing this service via dealer networks.

Project info =>[bit.ly/onchain-vin ](https://bit.ly/onchain-vin)

title: Amplifying Cardano's Global Presence Through Event Video Coverage
problem: **Cardano has untapped potential to expand its global influence. Attending and documenting blockchain events can boost Cardanos visibility and position it as a leader in the ecosystem.**
solution: **We will attend and document blockchain events globally, creating engaging video content to raise Cardano’s visibility, showcase its innovations, and expand its influence through storytelling.**
